subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary Man cannot change the basic structure of nature. They can control something that is harmful for nature. Greenhouse effect is one of them. The main cause of it is the increase in carbon dioxide level in the atmosphere because of the burning of fossil fuels. Every year enormous areas of forests are destroyed by people to obtain wood. The burning of trees and fossil raw material releases carbon dioxide in the atmosphere and the cutting down trees also means to destroy the natural agent of reducing carbon dioxide and producing oxygen. By avoiding some unwise activities we can save our earth from greenhouse effect.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Safiuddin Sarker Academy and College, Tongi, Gazipur. Sl. No. 20; Page No. 67
